A.action: 2 x 6-drawing walk in from the left (stance foot pinned), stop, head replaced from looking down at the envelope to the window

B.action: cord pulls at 1.15 and 2.35 s swing the bell; clapper on its own pin lags 0.08 s at 1.9x; strikes 1.4 and 2.6 s; motion arcs near strikes

C.action: arm raised by FK, three 4-drawing knocks with knuckles on the door face, then she leans in to listen, fist still raised

D.action: 2-drawing tear, key drawn out of the envelope's mouth and raised to the face, surprise head (protected), the man's shadow slides into the window

E.action: r1: held rest while the camera travels; anticipation dip at 0.25 s; 4-drawing lift to the overshoot+glint at 0.58 s, settle by 0.75 s; skyward head v_sky 0.50-1.67 s (face to the panel top), then v_up on the key (page pose); a breath through the dwell; the thread swings out

F.action: 4-drawing set-down of the key on the bench, release, shrug head, replacement profile turns her, one dejected walk cycle out left

G.action: 4 hand-over-hand hauls (fast down-stroke, slower recovery), leaning into each pull; knots travel down the cord; the slack coils at his feet

H.action: the door window's light goes out (lit, dim, dark)

I.action: thread tightens, the key slides bow-first under the shut door in 6 drawings and stops half under; the door never opens
